column1: # stage 2: the instance's seven statements against FS114-Y6's theorem table

column3: in a pinwheel with E1 at edge 1: `w_1 = q_4`, `α_1 = 60°`, `t_1` lies in the Reuleaux cap `Reul(p, q_4, e(φ_1 − 120°)) ∖ B(q_1, 1)`, `t_2 ⊂ Reul(p, q_4, q_1)` with `q_4 ∈ cl t_2`, and `α_2 < 120°`
FS114-Y5-CASE holds at `q_3` in E1 (edge 1 only, no E2 at `t_3`, `t_4`), so `α_4 ≥ 120°`
the tile `Ω` at `q_4` holding the directions just above `270°` has colour `m̄_3 = m_2`, and `Ω ≠ μ_3`

**E1 forces a second 60° arc**: `t_2` borders the whole ring arc from `q_4` to `q_1`; the tactic tile `T_4` borders all of it from outside, contains `q_1` and lies in the Reuleaux cap `Reul(q_4, q_1, q_1 + q_4) ∖ B(p, 1)`; `α_4 = 120°` exactly (`φ_3 = φ_1 + 180°`), `α_2 + α_3 = 180°`, CASE (A) at `q_3` with `λ_3 = α_3 − 60°`

in E1 with `μ_1` bordering all of `M_1` and `α_2 > 60°`, the P_x kill of FS114-Y5-PXKILL runs at `k = 1` (`T_1` against `O_2`, colour 1) unless `T_4` fills the cap's corner at `q_4` and a tile of colour `m_2` sits at `q_1` between `T_1` and `μ_1`

E2 at one blade `t_{c+1}` (no E1) breaks only ALT(`μ_{c−1}`, `μ_c`), hence only POCKET at `w_c` and CASE at `q_c`, and there only case (B)'s `α_c = 60°` and (A)'s `α_c − λ_c ≤ 60°`; (A) at `q_c` still gives `α_{c−1} + α_c ≤ 180°` and so leads to `P_x`; `P_x` is still excluded (Y5-PXKILL at `k = c + 1` reads no pocket beside `t_{c+1}`); the survivors are the cone sequences S1–S6 of §3.2, all with `t_{c+1}` short of the ring's clockwise tangent at `q_c`

in a `(2, 1, 1, 0)` pattern whose two-edge tile `t_1` is a width-1 Reuleaux triangle, FS114-Y4-SIDES, FS114-YB3-D2T and FS114-Y4-W hold unchanged: the side tiles at its corners are 5 and 6, and the tile along its ring arc is one cap tile `W`, of the colour of the tile opposite `t_1` at `p`; the stop at `√3` is **not** inherited, since Y3's germ condition at `r` needs the slivers that FS114-Y4-DIAG derived from the second Reuleaux triangle
